value: DenseNet121 with liver+spleen+difference channels + attenuation stats

Tuned after reviewing the first DenseNet121 run.
Main changes:
- restored explicit input normalization from the older stable scripts
- replaced small-batch BatchNorm head with LayerNorm head
- reduced regularization slightly and lowered LR for steadier fold-to-fold training
- unfreezes the last two DenseNet stages with a smaller backbone LR
Uses 3 input channels:
1) liver ROI
2) spleen ROI
3) signed liver-spleen difference map
and concatenates attenuation stats before final classification.
